concept: A double booking as two black tent cards on one butter-yellow table, rendered in 3D (Blender): both say TABLE 4, RESERVED, 19:30. Low and wide: who gets table 4? Close on the first card: Ellis booked online. High and close on the second: Patel booked by phone. Then the same camera, and the card flips to 20:00: one diary for website and phone bookings, so Patel gets the next slot. Butter yellow, black card, cream print and one cobalt word a scene.
